tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("focus_billing.csv")
df["BillingPeriodStart"] = pd.to_datetime(df["BillingPeriodStart"])
df["ChargePeriodStart"] = pd.to_datetime(df["ChargePeriodStart"])

print("BillingPeriodStart values:", df["BillingPeriodStart"].unique())
print("ChargePeriodStart range:", df["ChargePeriodStart"].min(), df["ChargePeriodStart"].max())

sub = df[(df["SubAccountName"] == "staging") & (df["BillingPeriodStart"] == "2026-09-01")]
print("rows:", len(sub))
res = sub.groupby("ServiceName")["BilledCost"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(res)
print(res.head(3).index.tolist())
